title: Use modernc.org/sqlite for CGO_ENABLED=0 builds
content: We switched the store package to modernc.org/sqlite (pure-Go) instead of mattn/go-sqlite3 so `go build ./cmd/engram` works with CGO_ENABLED=0 and produces a single static binary with no C toolchain dependency at build time.

title: Fix FTS5 crash on interior double quotes
content: sanitizeFTS did not escape interior double-quote characters before building an FTS5 MATCH query, so a saved observation containing a literal " character crashed the FTS5 query planner with a syntax error at search time. Fixed by escaping embedded quotes before quoting each token for FTS5.
key_facts: root cause: unescaped interior double quotes in sanitizeFTS
symptom: FTS5 MATCH query syntax error / crash
fix: escape embedded quotes before quoting tokens
gold_query: FTS5 crash on double quote in search query

title: topic_key format for upserts
content: topic_key must be slash-separated lowercase kebab-case with at most two levels, like architecture/auth-model or bugs/fts5-quote-crash. This keeps FTS5 tokenization predictable and lets mem_save upsert in place (same project+scope+topic_key updates the existing row and increments revision_count) instead of creating a new row on every save.
key_facts: same project+scope+topic_key upserts and increments revision_count

title: Soporte de idioma español en captura pasiva
content: mem_capture_passive ahora reconoce encabezados de "Aprendizajes clave" en español, no solo "## Key Learnings" en inglés, para que las sesiones en español también extraigan observaciones automáticamente.
key_facts: antes solo reconocía "## Key Learnings" en inglés
gold_query: captura pasiva en español aprendizajes clave

title: Cloud autosync backoff policy (v1)
content: Autosync backs off exponentially after 3 consecutive push/pull failures, capping the wait at 5 minutes, and reports reason_code=backoff via /sync/status while waiting.
gold_query: when does autosync start backing off

title: Cloud autosync backoff policy (v2, supersedes v1)
content: Revised: autosync backs off exponentially after 5 consecutive push/pull failures (raised from 3 to reduce noisy false backoffs on flaky networks), capping the wait at 10 minutes (raised from 5), and still reports reason_code=backoff via /sync/status while waiting.
key_facts: backoff threshold raised from 3 to 5 consecutive failures
gold_query: current autosync backoff threshold and cap
